evidence.quote: Amazon CloudFront announces support for hybrid post-quantum key establishment across all existing Transport Layer Security (TLS) security policies, providing enhanced protection against future quantum computing threats for client-to-edge connections.
PQC support is available on all existing security policies by default, requiring no customer configuration.

evidence.heading: Amazon CloudFront launches TLS security policy with post-quantum support

evidence.quote: Quantum-safe key exchanges are only supported with TLS 1.3. TLS 1.2 and earlier versions do not support quantum-safe key exchanges.
Additionally, CloudFront launched a new TLS 1.3 only security policy that enhances TLS options between viewers and edge locations.
